title: Kobo 6.0 beta is breaking some e-readers.
summary: People are reporting endless loading screens , broken Libby integration, and missing data , including annotations and sideloaded books. Kobo is warning readers not to roll back the update , though, as it will make any missing data permanently unretrievable.
